subject.title: fix(providers): honor proxies in model discovery

question: Should fixed canonical HTTPS provider catalog endpoints be allowed to use operator-configured environment proxies, with custom/local endpoints and redirected origins remaining on strict routing?
rationale: This is an intentional trust-boundary classification across many providers, not a mechanical correctness choice that automated review can safely make.

options.title: Accept the bounded trusted-proxy policy
options.body: Approve the canonical-HTTPS-only classification after exact-head proof confirms proxy discovery and cross-origin redirect fallback remain bounded.

options.title: Keep all catalog discovery strict
options.body: Reject environment-proxy routing for vendor catalogs and retain static fallback behavior on proxy-required networks.

options.title: Narrow the approved vendor set
options.body: Restrict trusted-proxy mode to a smaller explicitly reviewed set of catalog owners before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded trusted-proxy policy
recommendation.body: Approve the canonical-HTTPS-only classification after exact-head proof confirms proxy discovery and cross-origin redirect fallback remain bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and the consolidation/redirect-scope commit history connect this decision most directly to steipete.
